initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream output is consistent with the evidence_sources handoff it received, but that handoff has provenance ranks in ascending demand order instead of the required demand-descending order. The captured assemble_provenance implementation sorts by demand_score without reverse ordering, producing this inverted provenance order.
